label: fashion
name: Fashion Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR fashion image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible garments, accessories, personal styling, cultural attire, and fashion presentation.

labels.clothing: An image primarily focused on clothing such as shirts, dresses, jackets, trousers, skirts, or other garments.
labels.footwear: An image primarily focused on shoes, sandals, boots, sneakers, slippers, or other footwear.
labels.jewellery: An image primarily focused on jewellery such as rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, or decorative ornaments.
labels.bags: An image primarily focused on handbags, backpacks, purses, clutches, or other fashion bags.
labels.watches: An image primarily focused on a wristwatch or fashion watch.
labels.eyewear: An image primarily focused on sunglasses, eyeglasses, or other fashion eyewear.
labels.makeup: An image primarily focused on makeup applied to a person or a completed cosmetic look.
labels.hairstyle: An image primarily focused on a haircut, hairstyle, hair colouring, or hair styling.
labels.outfit: An image primarily focused on a complete styled combination of clothing and accessories worn by a person.
labels.traditional_wear: An image primarily focused on traditional or cultural clothing such as sarees, lehengas, kurtas, sherwanis, or regional attire.
labels.formal_wear: An image primarily focused on formal clothing such as suits, gowns, blazers, or business attire.
labels.sportswear: An image primarily focused on athletic clothing, gym wear, tracksuits, or sports fashion.
labels.fashion_model: An image primarily showing a model posing to display clothing, accessories, or a styled fashion look.
labels.fashion_show: An image primarily showing models walking on a runway or participating in a fashion event.
